SYMPTOM: After Playwright uploaded 7 item crops, only 1 UUID was persisted to DB (the last one to complete). Other 6 lost.
CAUSE: `setImageSearchUUID` did read-search-record → parse items JSON → set uuid → write back. 7 concurrent calls all read the same original record, each wrote back with only their own UUID — last writer wins.
FIX: `batchPersistImageSearchUUIDs(searchId, uuids[])` — collect all UUIDs from the parallel Playwright uploads, then do a single Prisma update with all 7 at once. Logs 'Persisted 7 UUIDs to DB' confirming success.
PREVENT: Never do concurrent read-modify-write on the same Prisma record. Always batch mutations that happen in parallel.
